title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode8 Memories That Shine On

meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great work today!
Especially you, Ichi! You were so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it is unfortunate that we couldn't talk to Hanano and her brother afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There wasn't much we could do since they had a train to catch and we had to stay to clean up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it would've been nice to talk to them in person... But the manager said they seemed really happy, so that counts for something, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you think they already said goodbye to each other? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Be sure to have a proper breakfast every morning, okay? Otherwise, your head's gonna be running on fumes during class...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know already.
Actually, I could say the same for you...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: That part of you just never changes, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
I'll be fine, really...
You don't have to worry so much about me.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Alright, I have to go now...
I'm gonna be late if I don't catch the next train.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Let's see another show again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Once you've settled in at home... Promise, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that mean our song worked...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so!
No, I know so!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's hard to give a definite answer, but I sure hope so too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, that should be all the care products we need...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup! Still...
I'm glad our show went so well yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How many times have you said that now? I think you're up to a hundred if you include yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's no way I'm anywhere close to a hundred yet! I'd say thirty at most right now...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm gonna keep saying it a lot because it's a good thing♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I might have to agree with you there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This just means we need to keep doing our best during shows just in case Hanano and her brother come back to see us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's start doing super hyped-up shows that give them a chance to really cut loose♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, you're always super hyped up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay♪ You feeling it too, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As for who's feeling it... Miku and the others got so excited after we told them what happened.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and I felt so relieved when Miku said, “Good job”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, your eyes are sparkling...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it's business as usual.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, now that we put some smiles on the faces of our very first fans, let's start working towards taking the next step...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We're gonna get so many people to start coming to our shows!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (“Have Your Music Heard Around the World with Hatsune Miku!”)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I remember this...
I asked my parents to buy this for me when I was little, but they refused.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I even asked for it as a birthday present, but Mom said, “You don't even know how to use it, do you...?”)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I felt so sad that time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But I make my own money now...
And I could use it to practice writing songs.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure that other version of me is eagerly awaiting your arrival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi?
What's up? You spaced out there for a second.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to take these up to the front.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope Miku and I get a chance to sing together someday...)
